subject: Confidential: evaluation ops playbook & manager comms for sensitive roles
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Confidential: evaluation ops playbook & manager comms for sensitive roles

Team —

I put together a first-pass operations playbook for the upcoming evaluation cycle focused on high-risk / sensitive roles (finance, security, infra, and a small set of R&D roles flagged by managers). This is intentionally concise; the goal is a single doc managers can follow to run reviews that need extra confidentiality and auditability.

Highlights (attached):
- Timeline: staggered windows (managers notified 7/1, reviews open 7/15, calibration 8/10–8/14, communications 8/20–8/31).
- Forms: manager scoring sheet + redaction checklist (sensitive-role-checklist.xlsx).
- Comms: two manager email scripts (one for private/quiet launches, one for broader team comms).
- Audit & retention: an approach for storing redacted notes + legal review pointers (redaction-guidelines.pdf).

Asks: please review sections below and reply with your edits by EOD Wednesday. Specific questions:
1) Are the staggered windows too aggressive for teams with cross-functional contributors?
2) Any missing redaction/retention edge cases we should add before sending to Legal?
3) Can Marcus coordinate a brief with Talent Partners to run a walkthrough for people managers?

Attachments: sensitive-role-checklist.xlsx; manager_communication_templates_v1.docx; redaction-guidelines.pdf

Thanks — this is on our exec calendar next Thursday; want to have a stable draft by then.

— Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
People Ops Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Confidential: evaluation ops playbook & manager comms for sensitive roles

Thanks Mateo — quick read and a few inline notes below. I made suggested language changes to the "quiet launch" manager script (see doc v1 comments).

On Mon, Jun 7, 2027 at 09:15, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team —
> 
> I put together a first-pass operations playbook for the upcoming evaluation cycle focused on high-risk / sensitive roles ...

My quick feedback:
- Timeline: I think moving the manager notification to 6/28 gives a little more runway for managers who may need to source historical evidence. Can we shift notification earlier by a week?
- Calibration: prefer two half-days rather than a full week to limit interruptions; propose 8/10 morning + 8/12 afternoon.
- Redaction checklist: add a line about flagged PII (employee ID, passport) to be removed before shared drive archival.

Happy to take the lead on updating the manager script with the more formal language and escalation flow. I can push a revised doc by Wednesday morning.

Laura Bennett
Director, People Partners
Redwood Inference

Attachment: manager_communication_templates_v1_comments.docx (comments only)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: sarah@talentpartners.com
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Confidential: evaluation ops playbook & manager comms for sensitive roles

Looping in Sarah from Talent Partners for a quick vendor alignment — Sarah, we want to run a 30-min walkthrough of the playbook and the manager scripts next week. Please see the draft attachments Mateo shared.

A couple of operational notes from my side:
- Staggering is fine, but teams that cross people (e.g., infra+security) need a single source of truth for scoring. Suggest we publish a shared calibration sheet and lock edits during calibration windows.
- For procurement/contracted reviewers: treat contractor notes the same as employee notes, redact contractor company names when archived.
- I'll own coordination with Talent Partners. Proposed walkthrough slots: Tue 6/15 10:00–10:30 PT or Fri 6/18 14:00–14:30 PT.

Marcus Lin
People Operations Program Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 08 Jun 2027 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Confidential: evaluation ops playbook & manager comms for sensitive roles

Thanks all — good input. I've incorporated Laura's timing suggestion and Marcus's lock-down approach. Updated plan (high level):

- Manager notification: 2027-06-28 (email + calendar hold).
- Reviews open for managers: 2027-07-15 to 2027-08-05 (3-week window).
- Calibration: two half-days 2027-08-10 09:00–12:00 PT and 2027-08-12 13:00–16:00 PT (calendar invites to follow).
- Team communications: small-group quiet launches 2027-08-20–24; org-wide summaries 2027-08-31.
- Data retention: redacted manager notes archived to restricted Drive folder for 7 years; raw notes retained only for approved audit requests.

Manager comms (snippets for use):
- Quiet launch script (for managers with sensitive headcount): "We are beginning a confidential review window for a small set of roles. This process includes restricted evidence collection; please avoid sharing feedback externally and follow the redaction checklist before uploading any artifacts."
- Broader team script: "Feedback cycles complete on 8/5. Managers will share outcomes privately with individuals starting 8/20. If you have questions about process, contact People Ops."

Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-eval-playbook
Attachments: sensitive-role-checklist.xlsx; manager_communication_templates_v1.docx; redaction-guidelines.pdf

Next steps: Marcus to confirm Talent Partners slot by EOD. Laura to upload revised manager script. Neha & Legal to confirm retention and redaction language for final doc. I'll consolidate and publish a v1 playbook by Friday.

— Mateo
People Ops Lead
Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: audit@compass-audit.com
Date: Tue, 08 Jun 2027 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Confidential: evaluation ops playbook & manager comms for sensitive roles

Agree with the plan. A couple of legal/controls asks before we publish v1:
- Confirm who on the People Ops team will have write access to the restricted Drive folder (we should limit to 4 people max).
- Add an explicit step that managers must run manager notes through the redaction checklist before attachment to the restricted folder. We should also capture a short "redaction confirmation" checkbox on the manager form.
- For audit readiness: include a sample evidence packet template so auditors can request a consistent set of artifacts.

I've CC'd Compass Audit so they can confirm the evidence packet format offline. Marcus: please confirm Talent Partners slot and I'll shepherd the retention language with Legal.

Neha Kapoor
Head of Compliance & Privacy
Redwood Inference
